symptomShortText: Helium leak test rejected P90 housings - gas pores and shrinkage cavity at sealing face from die DIE1

causesIshikawa.description: Die cast operator followed DOC-3308 Rev D, no deviation logged
DIE1 chill vent block clogged with oxidised release agent - vacuum at shot 210 mbar vs max 80 mbar, gas trapped at the flange face
Die spray pattern unchanged, release agent dilution 1:80 as specified
Ingot lot ING-77501 hydrogen 0.14 ppm, within 0.20 ppm limit
Helium leak tester HLT-03 verified with reference leak at shift start
Foundry ambient 29C, no correlation with reject rate

fiveWhyChain.question: Why did the housings fail the helium leak test?
fiveWhyChain.answer: Gas pores and a shrinkage cavity broke through the machined sealing face, leak rate 13.1 against max 5 mbar*l/s

fiveWhyChain.question: Why were gas pores formed only on DIE1 castings?
fiveWhyChain.answer: DIE1 vacuum at shot was 210 mbar instead of below 80 mbar, so air stayed in the cavity during fill

fiveWhyChain.question: Why was DIE1 vacuum insufficient? (root cause)
fiveWhyChain.answer: The chill vent block was clogged with oxidised release agent because vent cleaning was not part of the PM schedule

actions.actionText: Quarantine batch B-60290 and 100% helium leak test all P90 housings before dispatch
Replace clogged chill vent insert on die DIE1 and restore vacuum below 80 mbar at shot
Add chill vent cleaning every 2,000 shots to the preventive maintenance schedule in SAP PM for all die casting cells

fmeaLink.description: Trapped gas at flange face from die vent blockage

lessonsLearned.whatWorked: Shot vacuum logging separated DIE1 from DIE2 on the same ingot lot within a day
lessonsLearned.whatDidnt: Vent cleaning depended on operator judgement and had no interval in SAP PM

isIsNot.isWhereWhenItHappens: P90 sealing face - WC-CAST-03-DIE1 - batch B-60290, late May 2026
isIsNot.isNotWhereWhenItDoesnt: WC-CAST-03-DIE2 castings from the same ingot lot ING-77501
isIsNot.notes: Defect follows the die, not the ingot lot
